content: nix flake check evaluates the flake and builds every attr in the checks.<system> output for the current system only (--all-systems for others). It also evaluates (not builds) nixosConfigurations, homeConfigurations, packages, devShells for the current system. Therefore host closures and HM activation packages are NOT fully built by default 'nix flake check' unless wired as checks — the standard pattern is checks.<system>.<hostname> = self.nixosConfigurations.<h>.config.system.build.toplevel (or .homeConfigurations.<h>.config.system.build.activationPackage for standalone). formatter.<system> is called by nix fmt. devShells optional (this project is config, not a dev repo). Source: nix manual nix3-flake-check + nix.dev concepts/flakes (official).
